rubrics.justification: Describes features broadly consistent with a 3AB blastocyst: expanded cavity, compact A-grade ICM, looser B-grade TE, visible/thinning zona and possible handling-related collapse. Some image-specific claims are slightly speculative from a single still frame.
Strong integration of age, ovarian reserve, BMI, unexplained infertility, prior IVF outcomes, semen parameters, endometrial thickness, lifestyle, and embryo morphology into prognosis and planning.

Reasoning is logical and mostly consistent, with the implantation estimate appropriately tied to favorable age/endometrium and caution from prior failures and untested status. Minor overinterpretation of morphology and some broad statements slightly reduce rigor.

Recommendations are largely aligned with IVF practice: single embryo transfer at age 32, cautious stance on routine PGT-A, attention to luteal support and uterine evaluation after repeated failures. A few suggestions are more practice-based than guideline-driven, but nothing clearly conflicts.

Provides clear next steps for current transfer and future cycles, including SET, luteal support, lifestyle changes, uterine reassessment, stimulation optimization, selective sperm DNA fragmentation testing, and nuanced discussion of PGT-A.
